cli.flagLang: language of the output: en or pl (default: S99WAILS_LANG, then the OS locale)
cli.headingMoreInfo: Use "{{.Command}} [command] --help" for more information about a command.
frontendgen.flagOut: output directory for the emitted composables
frontendgen.flagS99ab: also emit the s99ab bridges (for apps that extend @smegg99/s99ab)
frontendgen.long: frontendgen writes the s99wails TypeScript composables into a directory of the app's frontend, each file marked as generated. Run it from go:generate.
frontendgen.short: Write the s99wails composables into an app's frontend tree
webbench.errGpu: --gpu takes always, ondemand or never, not {{.Value}}
webbench.errMatrix: every render path failed to measure
webbench.flagConsole: mirror the page's console to stdout
webbench.flagDir: directory of a built SPA to serve over loopback and measure
webbench.flagGpu: hardware acceleration policy: always, ondemand, never
webbench.flagMatrix: run the default render-path comparison, one child process per configuration
webbench.flagWorkload: page (drive the page's own content) or synthetic (build a list first)
webbench.long: s99webbench loads a page in a WebKitGTK window and reports load, frame and style timing. --matrix runs one child process per render path and compares them. It needs cgo, gtk3, webkit2gtk-4.1 and a display.
webbench.short: Measure a page inside WebKitGTK and compare render paths
